items.question: What is Clean-to-Earn?
items.answer: Clean-to-Earn is our core model: participants who remove plastic from beaches, rivers, or underwater sites earn rewards for verified work. Mainstream users start with EcoPoints; self-custody users can later use the on-chain protocol.

items.question: How is cleanup verified?
items.answer: Every cleanup goes through layered verification: GPS and timestamp checks, photo review, edge computer vision, behavioral limits, and Buddy-Dive dual-signature for underwater work. The goal is a strong audit trail without exposing personal data on-chain.

items.question: What is the PLASTIC token?
items.answer: PLASTIC is a B2B-only plastic recovery credit. 1 PLASTIC = 1 kg of verified removed plastic, recorded on Base L2. Corporate partners can burn PLASTIC for an auditable impact certificate; it is not intended for retail distribution.

items.question: Why Base L2?
items.answer: Base offers low-cost transactions, EVM compatibility, strong tooling, smart-wallet support, and broad developer adoption. It is a practical proof layer for many small environmental reward and verification events.

items.question: When is mainnet launch?
items.answer: We are currently on Base Sepolia testnet (Phase 0). Mainnet launch is planned for Q1 2027 after an external security audit. Join our newsletter to get notified.

items.question: Is the code open-source?
items.answer: Yes. Smart contracts, the dApp, and the TypeScript SDK are fully open-source on GitHub under the MIT license. The backend AI pipeline and mobile app remain private to protect our proprietary verification IP.
